concepts.evolution:
The task starts with a product or company and a test objective. If the specification is incomplete, the Research Loop finds target and comparable product material and records source-linked findings in its Obsidian-compatible vault. REA is available for a scoped question when an authorized compatible artifact exists. Evidence about the target, analogous behavior, and demo assumptions retain their attribution. A reviewed representative spec supplies requirement IDs and expected outcomes. Exact source and confidence for a timing or behavior claim remain reviewable in the RTM.

Earlier pilot discussions reported a manually extracted dialysis spec, a runnable simulator, and backend tests. The current packet has no raw run evidence. A complete spec lets an experiment start directly from the scenario. The open question is which exact pilot revision and timing criteria will anchor Stage Zero.

concepts.evolution: The initial lifecycle discussion was framed as assembly-driven SDLC. Choose demo fidelity and plan what to reuse, adapt, mock or build. Feasibility should reflect issues back to the source: evidence gaps go to research, behavior ambiguity to the spec, and component gaps to the assembly plan. Carry the requirement, test, observations and verdict through the RTM. A mock can provide the zero-flow stimulus. The tested response must execute in the simulator and be observable. Pattern A was discussed as propagation and Pattern B as guided selection. Exact integration remains open. Knowledge Hub/Git vault connection and a reusable pattern library are later capabilities.

concepts.evolution:
The initial proposal used an orchestrator and state machine. Govi reframed the sandbox as a capability an agent uses on behalf of the human, like a calculator. The playbook records available actions and when they apply. The agent chooses actions from the current state. The runner carries out bounded operations and saves results. Govi controls scope and changes to acceptance criteria.

The long-term visualizer is an editable design-and-try workspace. Human and agent can inspect or change the same assembly, run scenarios and compare traces. A future device panel or mobile app communicates with the simulator through commands, state, and events. The Stage Zero proposal uses the existing simulator/harness, a local runner, one saved baseline and a five-second variation. The editable visualizer and panel are later proof points.

concepts.evolution: The earlier Design Sandbox depicts scenario, target, independent oracle, evidence recorder, and Observatory. Carry those responsibilities into Spec-to-Simulator: scenario injects the stimulus, simulator generates behavior, harness evaluates approved outcomes, recorder persists observations, and the visualizer exposes them. Compare alarm and pump-off command timing against the same criteria. The model separates reproducible execution from agent judgment. See ARCHITECTURE.md for the source comparison.

concepts.evolution:
REA's skill guides a host agent that selects probes. MCP and CLI invoke the local runtime and return evidence. [REA skill](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/main/.agents/skills/reverse-engineer-anything/SKILL.md) · [Launcher](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/main/scripts/rea.mjs)

Craft Anything also has a skill/MCP investigation path. Its desktop/CLI rebuild path runs Study → Build → Check with bounded refinement, delegates building to a coding agent, and persists state and human requests. Consider it for a browser panel build. Functional pass criteria still come from our harness. [Skill](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/blob/main/crates/setup/src/skill.md) · [Rebuild](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/blob/main/crates/ai/src/rebuild/mod.rs)

concepts.evolution: APP was discussed as Agent Portability Protocol. Earlier architecture paired a durable GitHub diary with a local Context Package and a bootstrap/recovery service. Govi clarified that this experiment should manually carry the architect across surfaces and later explore GitHub communication. He requested concept-level court-note-style records, project memory, actions, evidence references and behavioral guidance. He selected Dhriti as the portable name. Runtime APP integration is deferred. The first downstream task is to see whether Gemini can recover and amend this architecture faithfully, then pass it to a receiving architect.
